messages.author: PC
messages.content_text:
New week - Just got to remember no trading on Monday and to control my emotions and not let my emotions control me, make my decisions based off logical thinking not off emotions. Trading is a game of patience and discipline, sitting back and thinking out my actions will allow me to go further than being emotional ever will, it's a marathon not a race. Remember to breathe and stay relaxed, I need to step away and smell the roses if i ever become overwhelmed. Build discretion - Find my bias, leg to get rebalanced, pull fib, don't do anything til .5 / POI gets hit and take proper entry triggers - Look for SMT while rebalancing, don't worry about the seconds chart and everything will work out just fine. Avoid trading the first 30 minutes if price is looking choppy, if ranges look choppy then just refrain from trading entirely, and if the trade leaves without me then that's fine, don't chase it. (edited)
